API docs by Redocly

FlyMine Web Services API (31.0.0)

Download OpenAPI specification:

FlyMine Support: support@flymine.org URL: https://www.flymine.org/ License: LGPL-2.1

FlyMine is an integrated database for Drosophila genomics providing powerful search and data warehousing capabilities for accessing integrated genomic, proteomic, and genetic data for Drosophila and related organisms. This API provides RESTful web services powered by InterMine, an open-source biological data warehouse system.

Authentication

Some endpoints require authentication via API token. Obtain a token using the /user/token endpoint with username and password, then include it as a query parameter in subsequent requests.

Formats

Most endpoints support multiple output formats including JSON, XML, TSV, and CSV.

query

Query operations for retrieving genomic data

Execute a query

Execute a PathQuery to retrieve data from FlyMine. Queries can be submitted in XML or JSON format and results can be returned in various formats.

Authorizations:
NonetokenAuth
query Parameters
query
required
string
Examples:
  • query=<query name="short genes on the X chromosome" model="genomic" view="Gene.id Gene.exons.id"> <constraint path="Gene.chromosome.primaryIdentifier" op="=" value="X"/> <constraint path="Gene.length" op="<" value="1000"/> </query> - Short genes on X chromosome (from original service.json)
  • query=<query name="eve gene query" model="genomic" view="Gene.primaryIdentifier Gene.symbol Gene.name Gene.length Gene.chromosome.primaryIdentifier Gene.chromosomeLocation.start Gene.chromosomeLocation.end"> <constraint path="Gene.symbol" op="=" value="eve"/> <constraint path="Gene.organism.name" op="=" value="Drosophila melanogaster"/> </query> - Query for even-skipped gene
  • query={ "from": "Gene", "select": ["primaryIdentifier", "symbol", "name", "length", "chromosome.primaryIdentifier"], "where": [ {"path": "organism.name", "op": "=", "value": "Drosophila melanogaster"}, {"path": "symbol", "op": "ONE OF", "values": ["eve", "ftz", "zen", "hb", "Kr"]} ], "orderBy": [{"path": "symbol", "direction": "ASC"}] } - JSON query for multiple developmental genes
  • query=<query name="transcription factor genes" model="genomic" view="Gene.primaryIdentifier Gene.symbol Gene.name Gene.goAnnotation.ontologyTerm.name"> <constraint path="Gene.goAnnotation.ontologyTerm.name" op="CONTAINS" value="transcription factor"/> <constraint path="Gene.organism.name" op="=" value="Drosophila melanogaster"/> </query> - Genes with transcription factor activity
  • query={ "from": "Gene", "select": ["primaryIdentifier", "symbol", "name", "pathways.name"], "where": [ {"path": "organism.name", "op": "=", "value": "Drosophila melanogaster"}, {"path": "pathways.name", "op": "CONTAINS", "value": "Notch"} ] } - Genes in Notch signaling pathway
  • query=<query name="wingless protein domains" model="genomic" view="Gene.symbol Gene.proteins.primaryIdentifier Gene.proteins.proteinDomains.name Gene.proteins.proteinDomains.description"> <constraint path="Gene.symbol" op="=" value="wingless"/> <constraint path="Gene.organism.name" op="=" value="Drosophila melanogaster"/> </query> - Protein domains of wingless gene

A definition of the query to execute in Path-Query XML or JSON format

format
string
Default: "tab"
Enum: "tab" "csv" "count" "json" "jsonobjects" "jsoncount" "xml" "html" "rdf+xml"

Output format

start
integer
Default: 0

The index of the first result to return

size
integer
Default: 10
Example: size=50

The maximum size of the result set

columnheaders
string
Default: "none"
Enum: "none" "path" "friendly"

Include column headers (only for flat-file formats)

token
string

Authentication token for private data access

Export query results as GFF3

query
required
string
Example: query=<query model="genomic" view="Gene.id Gene.exons.id"> <constraint path="Gene.chromosome.primaryIdentifier" op="=" value="2L"/> <constraint path="Gene.chromosomeLocation.start" op=">" value="10000000"/> <constraint path="Gene.chromosomeLocation.end" op="<" value="11000000"/> </query>

Save query results as a list

required
string
Example: query=<query model="genomic" view="Gene.primaryIdentifier"> <constraint path="Gene.goAnnotation.ontologyTerm.name" op="CONTAINS" value="transcription"/> <constraint path="Gene.organism.name" op="=" value="Drosophila melanogaster"/> </query>

name
required
string

Name for the new list (must be unique)

description
string

Description for the new list

tags
Array of strings

Generate code for a query

Generate client code in various programming languages for executing a query. Useful for integrating FlyMine queries into custom applications.

Authorizations:
NonetokenAuth
query Parameters
query
required
string
Example: query=<query model="genomic" view="Gene.symbol Gene.primaryIdentifier"> <constraint path="Gene.symbol" op="=" value="eve"/> </query>

PathQuery in XML or JSON format

lang
required
string
Enum: "python" "perl" "java" "ruby" "javascript" "curl"
Example: lang=python

Target programming language

Responses

FlyMine production server

https://www.flymine.org/flymine/service/query/code

Response samples

  • 200
Content type
text/plain
#!/usr/bin/env python

from intermine.webservice import Service

service = Service("https://www.flymine.org/flymine/service")
query = service.new_query("Gene")
query.add_view("symbol", "primaryIdentifier")
query.add_constraint("symbol", "=", "eve")

for row in query:
    print(row["symbol"], row["primaryIdentifier"])

template

Pre-configured query templates

Execute a template query

Execute a pre-configured template query with parameters.

Authorizations:
NonetokenAuth
query Parameters
name
required
string
Examples:
  • name=Gene_Pathways - Template for gene pathways
  • name=Gene_Protein - Template for gene protein domains
  • name=Gene_AdultFlyAtlas - Template for FlyAtlas expression

The name of the template to run

constraint1
string
Examples:
  • constraint1=Gene - Gene constraint
  • constraint1=Gene.symbol - Gene symbol constraint

Constraint path for parameter 1

op1
string
Examples:
  • op1=LOOKUP - Lookup operator
  • op1== - Equals operator

Constraint operator for parameter 1

value1
string
Examples:
  • value1=eve - even-skipped gene
  • value1=ftz - fushi tarazu gene
  • value1=zen - zerknullt gene
  • value1=hb - hunchback gene
  • value1=Notch - Notch receptor gene
  • value1=wingless - wingless signaling gene

Constraint value for parameter 1

extra1
string
Example: extra1=D. melanogaster

Extra constraint value for parameter 1

format
string
Default: "tab"
Enum: "tab" "csv" "count" "json" "jsonobjects" "jsoncount" "xml" "html"
Example: format=json
size
integer
Default: 10
Example: size=25

Get enrichment widget data

Statistical enrichment analysis for a list

Authorizations:
NonetokenAuth
query Parameters
list
string
Examples:
  • list=PL FlyTF_site_specific_TFs - Transcription factors list
  • list=Gap_Genes - Gap genes list
  • list=Hox_genes - Hox genes list
  • list=Notch_Pathway - Notch signaling pathway genes

Name of the list to analyze

widget
required
string
Examples:
  • widget=go_enrichment_for_gene - GO enrichment widget
  • widget=protein_domains - Protein domains widget
  • widget=pathway_enrichment - Pathway enrichment widget

Name of the enrichment widget

maxp
number
Default: 0.05
Example: maxp=0.01

Maximum p-value

correction
string
Default: "Holm-Bonferroni"
Enum: "Holm-Bonferroni" "Benjamini and Hochberg" "Bonferroni" "None"
Example: correction=Benjamini and Hochberg
filter
string
Example: filter=biological_process

Optional widget-specific filter

population
string

Background population list name

format
string
Default: "json"
Enum: "json" "xml" "tab" "csv"
token
string
